theory.title: Reported statements and questions
theory.explanation: Use say and tell to report information. In reported statements, pronouns and verb tenses often move back one step when the reporting verb is past. In reported questions, use statement word order and no question mark inside the reported clause.
theory.tip: Fíjate en las referencias temporales y en la intención de quien habla. El contexto suele indicar qué estructura necesitas.
